Square-zero rank-\(r\) matrices are counted by flags \(\operatorname{im}A\subseteq\ker A\) and an isomorphism of the quotient onto the image. The degree strata are separated by a strict monotonicity estimate and finite graph reconstruction corroborates the formulas.
